home_quote.text: There is no doubt that PEMF technology has a place in rehabilitative treatment for populations suffering from pain and functional impairment in one of the medical conditions mentioned in this review.
home_quote.name: Prof. Gabi Zeilig, MD
home_quote.title: Director (retired), Department of Neurological Rehabilitation, Sheba Medical Center, Tel HaShomer

people.name: Prof. Gabi Zeilig, MD
people.title: Director (retired), Department of Neurological Rehabilitation, Sheba Medical Center, Tel HaShomer
people.summary: Reviews four decades of published PEMF research and concludes that it has a place in rehabilitation for people with pain and functional impairment.
people.headline: A medical review of PEMF therapy

people.name: Prof. Itamar Grotto
people.title: Former Associate Director General of the Israel Ministry of Health and former Head of Public Health Services
people.summary: Reviews the mechanism, the clinical indications and the safety profile of PEMF, and recommends integrating it in health institutions, starting with a pilot.
people.headline: Integrating PEMF technology in health institutions

people.name: Dr. Michael Savion
people.title: Senior urologist

people.headline: Combining shockwave with PEMF: a urologist's experience

people.name: Dr. Alexander Ginzburg

people.headline: PEMF in older age: a geriatrician's experience

people.name: Dr. Moasi

people.title: Physiotherapist, Lt. Col. (res.), former Head of the IDF Physiotherapy Corps
